summary.text: Cory Raymond is the Republican candidate for Maine House of Representatives District 41 in the November 3, 2026 general election, facing Democrat Joshua Gerritsen; there is no incumbent in the race.
He was also the Republican nominee for the district in 2024.

paragraphs.text: Cory Raymond ran in the 2024 general election for Maine House District 41 as the Republican nominee and lost to incumbent Democrat Victoria Doudera, 74.9 percent to 25.1 percent.
He advanced from the Republican primary on June 9, 2026.
